Package com.codedstream.otterstream.rules.engine

Class DefaultRuleEngine

java.lang.Object
com.codedstream.otterstream.rules.engine.DefaultRuleEngine
All Implemented Interfaces:
RuleEngine
public final class DefaultRuleEngine extends Object implements RuleEngine
The concrete RuleEngine used regardless of where the RuleSet came from (YAML, properties, or a hand-written RuleSetSource) — all three configuration paths converge here.

Performance notes

  • Every rule's condition is compiled once, at construction, via ExpressionEvaluator.compile(java.lang.String) — evaluate/evaluateBatch never parse a string. This is the single most important thing keeping evaluation off the "slow" side of the sub-5ms inference latency target.
  • Metrics use LongAdder, not AtomicLong — under high concurrent write contention (many parallel inference calls all incrementing the same rule's hit counter) LongAdder scales better by striping updates across cells, at the cost of a slightly more expensive read (LongAdder.sum()) — exactly the right trade-off here, since hit counters are written constantly but only read occasionally (dashboard polling).
  • evaluateBatch evaluates sequentially below PARALLEL_BATCH_THRESHOLD items and via a parallel stream above it — avoids paying fork/join overhead on small batches while still scaling for large ones.
Since:
0.1.0

      public Decision evaluate(InferenceResult inferenceResult, Map<String,Object> context) throws RuleEvaluationException
      Description copied from interface: RuleEngine
      Evaluates one inference result. Mode (SINGLE vs MULTIPLE matches) is governed by RuleSet.evaluationMode(), not a parameter here — it's a property of the rule set, not of an individual call.
      Specified by:
      evaluate in interface RuleEngine
      Parameters:
      inferenceResult - the inference result to evaluate
      context - additional fields to make available to rule conditions beyond what's in inferenceResult itself (e.g. request-scoped metadata); may be empty
      Returns:
      the resulting decision — Decision.unflagged(long) if no rule matched
      Throws:
      RuleEvaluationException - if a rule's condition fails to evaluate

      Description copied from interface: RuleEngine

      Parameters:
